title: Fixed the problem of missing the last number of consecutive labels
goal: Boundary error in positioning loops by single term and reverse interval.
summary: program generates a set of tag numbers from first to last. The existing implementation misses the last number, which is most easily seen at small ranges.
tasks: checks the loop condition of labelRange(first, last) and returns an integer array from first to last, containing both endpoints.
Returns one item when first is equal to last, and returns an empty array when first is greater than last.

example.note: When the right endpoint needs to be processed, check whether the loop allows n to be exactly equal to the endpoint.

hint: only adjusts the conditions that determine when to end. Review with an input where first and last are both equal to 4.
